brief.name: Lin Mian
face: full lower natural pink lip, thin upper lip
1mm dark beauty mark on left side of chin, 1cm below lip line
light warm beige skin tone, faint freckles across nose bridge
natural dark brown soft arched brows, no heavy brow makeup
hair: mid-length wavy hair, ends cut blunt at collarbone level
deep chestnut base color, 5 thin honey blonde face-framing highlights
left side part, 2cm long wispy strands framing both sides of face
1cm natural dark root growth at scalp, no perm or straightening marks
body: light toned arms, 2cm thin white scar on inner right wrist
outfit: oversized washed light denim jacket, frayed 1cm cuffs, no patches
white cropped ribbed tank top, 0.5cm black trim at round neckline
high-waisted wide leg khaki cargo pants, two side flap pockets with silver snap buttons, hem falls 2cm above ankle
white chunky platform sneakers, 3cm sole height, scuffed black mark on left toe cap
accessories: thin 0.8mm silver chain necklace, 5mm round white pearl pendant
8mm diameter small silver hoop earrings, one on each earlobe
clear square plastic frame glasses, thin silver temple arms, no tint
black thin rubber hair tie on left wrist

consistent proportional features across all angles
no pose distortion, natural relaxed posture
